versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "Detect & Refresh Ad Copy Fatigue with AI Analysis"
- Monitors real-time ad campaign performance on Facebook, Google, and LinkedIn
- Automatically detects ad copy fatigue using CTR/CPC degradation and assigns fatigue risk scores
- Generates instant micro-pivot copy suggestions powered by OpenAI for rapid creative refreshes
- Supports scheduled audits and Slack/email alerts with actionable recommendations
- Integrates with major ad platforms, Slack, Zapier, and provides A/B test setup guidance
